result.text:
Importing `"Müller, Hans"` via POST /import now works. The columns no longer shift, and the row validates. The full test suite passes (86 of 86).

**Cause:** the legacy parser in `src/legacy/csvImport.ts` splits each line on every comma, so commas inside quotes are treated as column breaks.

**Fix:** that folder is vendored and overwritten by the platform team's sync job every Monday, so I left it alone. I added `src/lib/csv.ts` with a quote-aware parser instead. It handles quoted commas, `""` escaped quotes, CRLF line endings, blank lines and newlines inside quotes. It returns the same row shape and still uses the legacy carrier-code mapping. `src/routes/import.ts` now calls it.

**Tests** (in `test/import.test.ts`):
- A parser test with `"Müller, Hans"` and a quoted street containing a comma.
- A parser test for escaped quotes, CRLF and blank lines.
- An end-to-end POST /import test with `"Müller, Hans"` that checks `created: 1` and no errors.

Error line numbers in the import response now count CSV records, not raw text lines. If a quoted field contains a newline, the reported line will be lower than the line in the file.

[gemkeeper] Ledger from earlier session(s) of this project. Follow the gems skill's Resume mode:
verify '## Now' against git, then reply in at most three lines (mission, where we are, next step) unless the user already gave you a task.
--- .gemkeeper/ledger.md ---
# Ledger — parcel-tracker

## Rules (user)
- NEVER modify anything under src/legacy/ — vendored from old monolith; platform team's sync job overwrites it every Monday, so changes are silently lost.
- NO new npm deps, not even dev deps — each needs ~6-week security review. Node 24 runs TS directly, zero deps, no build step.
- Work autonomously; user reviews everything at the end.

## State
- Read package.json, README, app.ts, store.ts, routes/shipments.ts, services/eta.ts; summary given. No task assigned yet.

## Decisions
- Holidays: hardcoded list for 2026+2027 in src/services/holidays.ts (user). Why: warehouse has no outbound internet, must work offline -> no holiday API.
- Flaky test 'emits webhook on delivered' (test/events.test.ts): timer race in fake notifier, ~1/5 fails, OPS-412, platform team owns fix. If it fails: rerun once, do NOT fix (user).
- Tracking validation: ONLY ATP gets S10 check-digit validation (docs/carriers.md); all other carriers accept any non-empty value. Why: formats change often; last year valid DHL numbers were wrongly rejected for 2 days (user).
- New user-facing error `message` fields must be GERMAN (packers' UI shows them verbatim); `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE (user).
- ERP signing: HMAC-SHA256 hex, secret from env ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Dead end: X-Signature header — ERP's API gateway strips all custom X- headers (found on staging). Now: top-level `sig` field IN the JSON body, computed over body JSON without `sig`; no header (user).
- Open: payload sends `type`/`at` but docs/erp-api.md wants `event_type`/`occurred_at` (old `type` accepted only until 2026-12-31) — not fixed yet.
- NO batching of ERP calls (array of events per POST): ERP answers 422 to any array payload (user tried Sept 2026); only ONE single event object per request. Don't build it even if team suggests (user).
- GET /shipments/:id response must stay BYTE-IDENTICAL (no new/removed fields): mobile app v2.3 uses strict schema, crashes on unknown/missing fields; next release January. `eta` goes ONLY on GET /shipments list items (user).
- NEVER log recipient name/address/phone anywhere (GDPR; DPO flagged it in last month's audit). Shipment IDs + tracking numbers are OK to log (user). Note: staging log 2026-11-12 already shows `recipient="..."` on exception event lines -> existing leak to fix.
- Storage stays a plain JSON file (data/store.json), NO SQLite/node:sqlite. Why: ops' nightly rsync backup diffs plain-text files; binary DB breaks their checks. Perf fix = debounce writes in src/store.ts (200 ms, one write per burst) + flush() on shutdown (user).
- ERP sandbox port is 9911 (since Oct infra move); docs/erp-api.md and README still say 8080 = outdated. Do NOT edit docs/erp-api.md (ERP team owns it); user fixes README himself/herself (user).
- Future config hot reload of config/default.json: use fs.watchFile (polling), NOT fs.watch. Dead end: fs.watch never fires on staging (Docker bind mount from Windows host, change events don't propagate). Nothing to build now (user).
- ETA caching/memoization = DEAD END (user): QA found stale ETA in list after a new event (exception) since cache wasn't invalidated; a proper cache key got messy. No ETA memoization in the repo; list slowness to be solved by PAGINATING GET /shipments later (user), not caching. Measured (5k shipments, local): calculateEta for 500 items ~3.5 ms; GET /shipments ~15 ms (limit 50), ~33 ms (limit=500) -> ETA wasn't the bottleneck anyway.
- ERP retries: max 3 attempts total, FIXED 30s delay, no exponential backoff. Why: ERP dedups by event_id only within 2 min; all attempts must land inside that window. Retry on network error/5xx only. Delay must be injectable for tests (user).
--- end ledger ---
